experiment_acceptance: SAME ATTACK SUBSTRATE: every condition (C1-full, C1-nohard, C2-naive, C3-Elastic) is scored against the IDENTICAL set of attack run_ids from the 10 new runs (2026-05-27/28). Record the exact run_id list scored per condition in a manifest; if a condition is scored on a subset (e.g. C1-full on 1-2 runs for LLM cost), the other conditions MUST be re-scored on that SAME subset to produce a like-for-like comparison row. Cross-condition rows that mix run sets are INVALID and must be rejected.

SAME GROUND TRUTH: all per-event classifications resolve against one labels source (experiment/corpus/ground-truth/labels.jsonl) whose coverage of the chosen run_ids is verified (every scored event has a label; count unlabeled events and report as a known gap, never silently drop). If labels do not exist for the new runs, that is a BLOCKER — flag it, do not proxy with May labels without an explicit documented mapping.

SAME SCORING LOGIC: identical metric definitions (TP/FP/FN, Precision, Recall, F2, FPR) and identical detection-window semantics applied to every condition via the shared eval helpers (compute_metrics.py, compute_fpr.py, bootstrap_ci.py). No condition may use a bespoke scorer. Beta for F2 fixed and stated (beta=2). Tie-break / dedup rules for alerts identical across conditions.

PER-CONDITION + AGGREGATE: results reported at two granularities — per-run point estimates AND an aggregate per condition with a 95% bootstrap CI (B=10000, same RNG-seeded procedure already used for the C3 reproducibility verdict). Aggregate method (micro vs macro over runs) declared and applied uniformly.
BOOTSTRAP CIs ON EVERY HEADLINE METRIC: P, R, F2 each carry a [lo, hi] 95% CI for every condition. Point estimates without CIs are not acceptance-complete.

C1-FULL EXISTS WITH REAL OUTPUT: C1-full produced actual classification artifacts under experiment/results/raw/C1-full/run_*/ from a live M1-M5 + M3 (OBSERVE->HYPOTHESIZE->EVIDENCE->CROSS-VALIDATE->CLASSIFY) execution — not a stub, not copied from C1-nohard. Spot-verify at least one run's raw agent transcript / message log shows the governance pipeline actually ran.

ADVERSARIAL CONTRAST IS COMPUTABLE: the dataset supports a C1-full-vs-C2-naive comparison under the 9 adversarial conditions (3 injection modes x 3 sophistication tiers) on the SAME runs, so the resilience claim is a measured delta (e.g. F2 retention / degradation under injection), not an assertion. Control (none/mixed) row present as the non-adversarial reference.

REPRODUCIBILITY CROSS-CHECK: a deterministic re-score of at least one non-LLM condition (C3 or C2-prepared) reproduces the saved numbers bit-for-bit (or within the documented bootstrap tolerance). The existing results/reproducibility/VERDICT.json schema (point estimate inside the other's CI) is reused for any May-vs-new comparison that is claimed.

PROVENANCE MANIFEST: a single machine-readable results JSON (or set) is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for the paper table, containing per condition: run_ids scored, n_events, TP/FP/FN, P/R/F2 point + CI, FPR, timestamp, code/commit or script version, and labels file hash. The paper table is generated/checked FROM this file, never hand-typed independently.
paper_acceptance: COMPILES CLEAN via the correct engine: MDPI engproc class compiles with the proper toolchain (pdflatex + bibtex/biber as the class requires, run to convergence: latex -> bib -> latex -> latex) producing camera_raedy.pdf with ZERO errors. Capture the log; warnings triaged. 'Compiles' = exit 0 AND a PDF whose page count > the current draft AND the Results section renders with the table.

RESULTS SECTION COMPLETE: contains ONE comparison table (or clearly-linked set) with REAL numbers for C1-full, C1-nohard, C2-naive, C3-Elastic across P, R, F2 (and FPR where defined), each with its 95% bootstrap CI, with the scored run set / n stated in the caption or text. Every cell traces to the results JSON.

NO FABRICATION / NO PLACEHOLDERS: no TODO, no XXX, no 'TBD', no lorem, no invented digits, no future-tense 'we will' / 'will be evaluated' / 'is expected to' sentences anywhere in Results or Discussion. The prior 'Validation Plan' future-tense language is fully converted to past tense reporting of what was done.

DISCUSSION GROUNDED IN THE TABLE: every quantitative claim in Discussion (ranking of conditions, magnitude of gains, resilience deltas) cites a number that appears in the results table; no Discussion number exists that is absent from the table. Direction of every comparison matches the data (manually re-verify the sign of each claimed improvement).

ADVERSARIAL-RESILIENCE CLAIM SUPPORTED BY C1-FULL-vs-C2 CONTRAST: the headline resilience claim is stated as the measured C1-full vs C2-naive difference under adversarial conditions (with CIs / overlap noted) and is honest about significance — if CIs overlap, the text says 'not statistically distinguishable', not 'outperforms'.

NO ORPHAN REFERENCES: zero 'LaTeX Warning: Reference ... undefined' and zero 'Citation ... undefined' in the log; every \ref / \cref / \eqref / \cite resolves; every \label is referenced or intentionally kept; figures/tables referenced in text exist.
BIBLIOGRAPHY RESOLVES: bibtex/biber runs with zero undefined-citation errors; references.bib entries used in-text all render in the bibliography; no '[?]' citation marks in the PDF.

HONEST SCOPING: any condition NOT run on the full 10 runs (e.g. C1-full on a subset) is stated explicitly in the paper as a scope/limitation, with the n disclosed. If a condition could not be run at all, it is framed as future work, never silently presented as complete.
validation_hooks: LATEX COMPILE HOOK (fresh memory): from a clean checkout run the documented build (e.g. latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode camera_raedy.tex OR the pdflatex+biber sequence the class needs) twice to convergence; assert exit 0, assert camera_raedy.pdf produced, grep the .log for '^!' errors, 'Reference.*undefined', 'Citation.*undefined', 'There were undefined references' -> any hit FAILS the gate.

NUMBER-CONSISTENCY HOOK: a script parses the source-of-truth results JSON and the numeric cells of the Results table in camera_raedy.tex and asserts every table number equals the JSON value within rounding tolerance (and every CI matches). Mismatch FAILS the gate. This is the anti-typo / anti-drift check between data and paper.

NO-FABRICATION / NO-FUTURE-TENSE AUDIT: grep the Results + Discussion sections for forbidden tokens (TODO, TBD, XXX, FIXME, 'will be', 'we will', 'is expected', 'placeholder', 'lorem', 'NN.N', 'XX') -> any hit FAILS. Plus: confirm every numeric literal in those sections also appears in the results JSON (no orphan numbers invented in prose).

SAME-RUNSET HOOK: parse each condition's results artifact, assert the set of run_ids used for any cross-condition comparison row is IDENTICAL across the compared conditions; assert labels-file hash identical across conditions; FAIL on divergence.

C1-FULL LIVENESS HOOK: assert experiment/results/raw/C1-full/run_*/ exists, is newer than the May archive, is non-empty, and differs from C1-nohard output (not a copy); spot-check one transcript shows the M3 5-phase pipeline executed.

REPRODUCIBILITY RE-SCORE HOOK: re-run the deterministic scorer (compute_metrics.py / compute_fpr.py with fixed seed) on one condition's stored raw output and assert it reproduces the published point estimates within bootstrap tolerance; reuse the VERDICT.json 'estimate-inside-other-CI' rule for any claimed reproducibility statement.
PDF SMOKE HOOK: open the built PDF, assert the Results table page renders with no '[?]' citation marks and no blank/overfull-driven missing cells; page count exceeds the pre-Results draft.
anti_fabrication_controls: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: paper numbers are generated from or diffed against the results JSON by the number-consistency hook; no number may enter the .tex by hand without the hook confirming it matches an artifact.

ARTIFACT-OR-IT-DIDNT-HAPPEN: every reported condition must point to a raw output directory + a scoring artifact with a timestamp and code/commit version; conditions lacking artifacts are reported as future work, never as results.

NO BORROWED NUMBERS ACROSS RUN SETS: forbid presenting a metric computed on the May archive as if it were on the new runs; if May numbers are used they are labeled as such and only inside the reproducibility comparison, not the main matrix.
DETERMINISTIC RE-SCORE REQUIRED for at least one condition to prove the pipeline is honest and re-runnable; non-reproducible numbers are rejected.

SIGNIFICANCE HONESTY: claims of superiority require non-overlapping CIs (or a stated test); overlapping CIs must be reported as 'not distinguishable'. The fresh-memory reviewer manually checks each comparative sentence against the CIs.
FRESH-MEMORY INDEPENDENCE: the Round-2 validator runs the hooks in a clean context with no knowledge of the desired conclusion, so the build/number/audit checks cannot be rationalized away.
conditions: C1-full MUST produce real artifacts from a live M1-M5 + M3 run; if LLM cost forces a subset, ALL other conditions are re-scored on that exact same subset for the comparison rows, and the n is disclosed in the paper as a limitation.
Ground-truth labels for the chosen new runs MUST be verified to exist and cover the scored events before any C1/C2 scoring is reported; absence of labels is a hard blocker, not a thing to paper over.
Every headline metric (P, R, F2, FPR) in the paper carries a 95% bootstrap CI (B=10000, seeded) per condition, per-run + aggregate, computed by the SAME shared scorer for every condition.

All three fresh-memory hooks (LaTeX compile-clean, results-JSON-to-table number consistency, no-fabrication/no-future-tense audit) PASS in a clean context before the paper is declared done; logs/outputs attached as evidence.

The adversarial-resilience claim is written as the measured C1-full-vs-C2-naive contrast under the 9 adversarial conditions with explicit significance language; overlapping CIs are reported as non-distinguishable.
A provenance manifest (run_ids, labels hash, code/commit, timestamps) accompanies the results JSON so the comparison is reproducible end-to-end.
